time: event j starts at j*86400 seconds; call at +600, request[600,1800), observation ends+3600. Every historical whole curve finishes before next call.
generator: user stable a,b,h iid Uniform(-1,1); independent event a_event,b_event,h_event same law, plus x,w~U(-1,1), dose index uniform0..6 (d=.4*index), V~U(0,1), standard normal meter errors. stable_history uses user a,b,h; uninformative_history uses fresh independent event a,b,h; behavior_shift uses stable user a,b,h for j<=8 and negatives for j>=9, not supplied to predictor. Scenario variants share exogenous arrays. Acceptance p=expit(-.3+1.1*d/2.4+.4*x-.3*w+1.1*h); A=I(V<p). Capacity fraction c=.55+.2*x+.15*a, bounded .2 through .9. Delay bins floor(3*(b+1)), ramp bins 2+floor(8*(b+1)/2), plateau request reduction1.5*A*c, ramp linear in elapsed/ramp bins from delay. After1800 exact debt repayment at1.5kW, fractional final30s cell then reference; bounds and3600 energy checked. Y=sum(request reduction_obs*30)/1800 signed unclipped, fixed request denominator, all refusals retained.
input_contract: At call use current observed d/2.4,x,w only; histories exactly j-3..j-1 public curves and their call conditions. No current observed power/A/Y, user id, scenario label, hidden a/b/h, future curves or global future statistics. Whole-user train/val/test disjoint; global calendar train<=6,val7..8,test9..11. At later test calls previous test outcomes may enter history only after their observed end; model weights/encoder/scaler never updated (prequential evaluation). New-training-user generalization with three past curves, not zero-history cold start.

methods.C1_history_summary: C0 + past3 condition means (3) + mean historical Y,lastY,response_fraction,mean conditional onset/1200 (fallback1 if none),mean longest threshold run/1200,mean post positive rebound kWh/.5 (6); total12 dims
methods.C2_history_shape: C1 + six transparent shape features: mean first/second600s request reductions dividedq, mean first/last600s within-window OLS slope times1200/q, chronological Y trend (last-first)/2, capped onset trend (last-first)/(2*1200); total18
methods.C3_history_PCA: C1 +6 PCA scores from flattened last3 full-cycle observed reduction curves/q (360 dims). Training-target rows' historical curves only; centered unwhitened randomized PCA6, iterated_power3, random_state18. No validation/test fitting; total18. Linear unsupervised representation, not deep/self-supervised B4.
methods.common_predictor: StandardScaler fit train, PolynomialFeatures degree2 include_biasFalse, Ridge alpha10 fit_interceptTrue solvercholesky. Same algorithm and fixed hyperparameters all methods; degree2 expands after raw-feature scaling. No clipping or hyperparameter selection, validation diagnostics only.
methods.history_rule: 30s interval curves, observed reduction>=.15kW at least1 bin, target metadata not used. Longest consecutive run, mean onset conditional on detected event; no detected response not equivalent true refusal. Complete finite curves required, no imputation.
methods.exit: Compare C3 against C2 and C1, not just C0. Report all20 paired seed MSE differences, MCSE, improvement counts and distribution-shift first/later calls. No stable PCA increment => no automatic neural-network expansion; test not tuned. Does not resolve taskbook deep representation or second resource mechanism.

evaluation: Primary future observed Y RMSE and MAE on240 test targets per scenario/repetition (80 held-out users x3 later calls); validation160 diagnostics, train960. Report per-event9/10/11 and x groups, all20 paired repetitions, not pooled variants as independent. Save fitted models and observed predictions before metric evaluator; raw test labels never passed to fit. Hidden generator parameters not used for scoring or input. No causal effect/individual willingness truth claims.
scope: B1 representation usefulness benchmark only, not full B2/B4 or deep model implementation; no new dependency/GPU/UI/upload/commit. Existing74 models and prior studies protected, new independent data/work version. Full histories only; missing/cold-start future work.
reuse: installed sklearn1.7.2 NumPy2.2.6 SciPy1.15.3; official sklearn GitHub BSD3 maintained PCA/Ridge primitives. No library upgrade, use existing CPU for bounded linear representation baseline; resource decision for any later deep training requires method purpose and measured scale first.
